article-meta.article-title: Archival Dispatch: 32 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Voices of History, Ethel and Albert, Sleepy Joe, Jimmy Wakely, and Frontier Town
article-meta.kwd-group: Florence Nightingale, Charge of the Light Brigade, Howard Carter, King Tut, Arthur Conan Doyle, Robert Oppenheimer, Ethel and Albert, Peg Lynch, Jimmy Wakely, Sleepy Joe, Frontier Town, Original Filenames

sec.title: Batch 60 Forensic Discoveries
sec.p: Batch 60 marks a monumental milestone with **32 canonical broadcasts dated and indexed**, spanning foundational 19th-century audio cylinders and historic speeches (including the earliest recorded voices of Florence Nightingale, the Bugler of the Charge of the Light Brigade, Howard Carter recounting King Tutankhamun's tomb discovery, Sir Arthur Conan Doyle, and J. Robert Oppenheimer's atomic reflection), 6 domestic comedy gems from Peg Lynch's ***Ethel and Albert*** (NBC Monitor, 1957–1958), 8 Christmas and Uncle Remus folk tales from ***Sleepy Joe*** (starring Jimmy Scribner, 1948–1949), 8 western swing variety broadcasts from ***The Jimmy Wakely Show*** (CBS/AFRS, 1953), and 4 Western frontier legal dramas from ***Frontier Town*** (starring Reed Hadley as Chad Remington, 1952).
